newsitem.title: USA: Eagle Q3 hurt by credit reserve amendment.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Q3 hurt by credit reserve amendment.

text.p: Eagle Finance Corp said Thursday its third quarter decline in net income was mainly due to a change in the way the company establishes reserves for credit losses.

The provision for credit losses totaled $1.7 million and $6.6 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 1996, respectively. No comparable credit loss provision was made in the third quarter of 1995 and a $53,000 provision was made in the nine month period ended September 30, 1995, Eagle said.

"The substantial decline in net income, from the comparable periods last year, is primarily due to the difference in the manner in which Eagle established reserves for credit losses during the comparable periods," Eagle said in a release.
Eagle reported 1996 third quarter earnings of $0.05 per primary common share versus $0.34 last year.
